description: Fetch a Hugging Face Space's full metadata by repo id, e.g. multimodalart/minimax-h3 (or full URL https://huggingface.co/spaces/multimodalart/minimax-h3). Returns likes, SDK type (gradio/streamlit/static/docker), tags, linked models, runtime (stage/hardware/replicas), region, host/subdomain, and created/updated dates. Reads via HF's internal API from the browser; no login required.

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Space repo as org/name (e.g. multimodalart/minimax-h3) or full URL https://huggingface.co/spaces/multimodalart/minimax-h3.
